descByPlatform.chatgpt: Premium Brand Announcement Graphic for Brand Announcement Story Instagram vertical story. Subject: a full-bleed diagonal gradient from brand-gradient-start-violet #6A3AB8 top-left to brand-gradient-end-fuchsia #D24A8E bottom-right filling the 9:16 canvas, an oversized Inter ExtraBold 120pt headline 'NOW LIVE' set centred 50% x, 30% y in cream-card #F6EEDC paper warmth, a gold-accent-line #D4B46A 2px horizontal hairline rule below at 50% x, 44% y spanning 40% width, small Inter 16pt '— the autumn edit / new collection' below rule in cream-card, a rounded cream-card #F6EEDC pill 82% width at 70% y holding a flat-lay composition of three hero product silhouettes (bottle, book, fabric swatch) casting subtle shadow-aubergine #2A0E2A shadows onto the pill. Composition: Centered axis 50% x, Rule of Thirds headline upper-mid 9:16 vertical Story, type 68% safe area, pill bottom 26% safe area. Camera: Phase One XT 80mm top-down flat-art rig at f/11, 1/125s, ISO 50, tethered. Lighting: Diffused Overhead Soft-Box — 4×6ft silk scrim overhead 1.8m (key even), 2×3ft white card bounce camera-right 0.8m (fill), no rim. Capture One Warm-12 LUT grain 5 +0.1 EV. References: Glossier launch stories, Aesop brand reveal, Off-White drop graphic. Exclude: cluttered props, flat lighting, plastic sheen, color cast, logo distortion.
